title: Few-Shot Prompting
description: Master few-shot learning with examples to improve model accuracy and consistency.

data.text: Few-shot prompting provides examples in the prompt to teach the model the desired output format and behavior. This improves accuracy and consistency.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Few-shot provides examples for the model to learn from
Include diverse examples covering edge cases
Use delimiters to separate examples from input
Balance between few-shot and token cost
data.takeaway: Few-shot prompting is one of the most effective techniques for improving LLM output. Provide clear, diverse examples to teach the model the desired behavior.
